integrity: Proof by degree-prescribed leaf pruning and surjective Prüfer words; exact two-leaf Palm construction and occupancy law; Stirling-polynomial real-rootedness argument; complete exact-rational finite replay. Unconditional cherry mean is prior work, not an originality claim.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled Cayley trees, n>=4, unrestricted leaf-twin pairs; no extension to other random-tree ensembles or all tree statistics; some historical material may implicitly contain the formula.
title: Leaf-twin bias induces strict likelihood-ratio ordering in uniform labeled trees
